title: Reconciliation with God
definition: Reconciliation with God is God's act of bringing sinners who were His enemies into peace and fellowship with Himself through Christ.
summary: Reconciliation with God is the restoration of peace between holy God and sinners through Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ makes peace by His cross and brings believers near to God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Reconciliation with God means enemies are brought into restored relationship with Him through Christ. Scripture teaches that sin creates alienation, not merely personal regret or broken self-esteem.

God does not wait for sinners to repair the relationship by their own strength. He acts in Christ to remove hostility, forgive guilt, and bring people near.

Jesus is the Mediator of reconciliation. Through His cross, those who were far off are welcomed into peace with God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often seek relief from consequences while remaining distant from God. This doctrine shows that salvation restores relationship with the living God, not just legal status or inner peace.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Draw near to God as one reconciled through Christ. Lay down hostility, confess sin, pursue peace with others where possible, and become a messenger of reconciliation through the Gospel.
